## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is GPG signed (`git config commit.gpgsign true`)
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes locally
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally
- [ ] New hooks are exported from `src/index.ts`
- [ ] New hooks are covered by tests in `tests/hooks.test.tsx`
- [ ] README updated if the public API changed
